events.title: GreeDrill - Free demo gameplay (Next Fest)
events.summary: Live now: real runs of the free GreeDrill demo, all day long during Steam Next Fest.Drill deep, grab the gold, and surface before your drill overheats. Fight 6 brand-new mini-bosses, face the Guardians and pay off the Company's debt.The demo is free: play it right now from this page, and wishlist GreeDrill to be notified on release day, December 10, 2026.Join us on Discord: https://discord.gg/5nPfERtadN

events.title: Round two: real mini-boss fights and a clearer mine
events.summary: You kept playing and kept writing to us. Thank you! This second update is built from that new feedback. "Mini-bosses are just a button" 6 brand-new mini-bosses, each one a different mini-game: a boxing duel, a rhythm fight, a stealth game in the dark, a memory game, a shooting gallery and a chase. Each boss has its own arena, its own music, an intro cutscene and 3 phases that change the rules. events.title: You asked, we listened: big demo update
events.summary: Thanks for all your feedback on the demo! This update is built from it. A big step forward for the interface Brand new step-by-step tutorial that explains every part of the screen Clearer quota: an hourglass shows the exp Cleaner screen: simpler hold panel and far fewer pop-ups Your first building is free, and the license tree and relic shop now guide you New gameplay Combo rush: drill fast and the screen heats up Hold overload: keep drilling past full, but every extra ore heats your drill Also

events.title: Demo update: FPS limit, Restart button, cleaner pause menu
events.summary: Thanks for playing the GreeDrill demo and for all the feedback. Here is what changed.PerformanceNew FPS LIMIT setting: 60, 120, 144, 240 or Uncapped (144 by default). The demo no longer runs your GPU at full load.The game drops to 15 FPS while its window is in the background.RestartRestart the current level from the pause menu, in a brand new mine. Your licenses and coins are kept.Pause menuSimpler pause menu: Resume, Restart, Settings, Quit to menu. Sound, display and language are under Setting
